title: Testing and Assignment Accommodations
description: Modifications to how assignments and tests are presented, paced, and completed. Use when the student needs assignment chunking, alternative response formats, test-format adjustments, or scheduling supports to demonstrate learning.

source.name: ADayInOurShoes — Ultimate List of IEP Accommodations, Modifications & Strategies (SDIs)

accommodations.text: Monthly, weekly, or bi-weekly phone or in-person conferences with parents (progress monitoring).
Homework assignments chunked down by the teacher to define each task.
Have the child write down verbal questions to aid in processing.
Alternatives for completing assignments (typed instead of written, or verbal).
Frequent test breaks with opportunities to move.
Masking test items so only single questions are visible.
Permission to hand in all assignments late, as pre-determined.
Modify assignments to only include essential content.
Intersperse easy and difficult demands on an 80/20 basis (and work to increase difficulty over time).
Longer assignments broken down and scheduled out in pictures or words.
